name: hypo-workflow
description: Semantic Cycle, Goal, Plan, Experiment, and Memory workflows with readable local records and restart-safe recovery for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Readable semantic project workflows for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Hypo-Workflow gives Codex a semantic project workspace built from readable Cycle, Plan, Progress, Execution, Discussion, Experiment, and Memory files, with Goal and Plan delivery modes, bounded recovery, concurrent work placement, and narrow safety guardrails.
capabilities: Six semantic and safety lifecycle Hooks
Cycle-scoped Goal and Stone-based Plan delivery
Reproducible Experiment management and instant status
Concurrent Work Placement and Repository Targets
defaultPrompt: Discuss this delivery thoroughly, then choose Goal or Plan by Stone count.
Set up and manage a reproducible experiment lane.
